officialPublicSpaceChecks.durationCaveat: The browsed main source declares 180 seconds; the actual V12 rejection reports 270 seconds. These are separate observations. No explanation, free limit or retry suitability is inferred.
officialPublicSpaceChecks.conclusion: Does not provide the required verified standalone existing-mesh paint route.
